content:
Here is a production-ready Crossplane XRD and Composition using the `function-patch-and-transform` pipeline mode. It strictly follows Crossplane v1.14+ idioms, satisfies all acceptance criteria, and demonstrates environment separation via `ProviderConfig` routing.

### 1. Composite Resource Definition (XRD)
```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: spineinfra.infra.example.com
spec:
  group: infra.example.com
  names:
    kind: SpineInfra
    plural: spineinfras
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              required:
                - environment
                - region
                - bucketName
                - dbName
                - iamRoleName
              properties:
                environment:
                  type: string
                  enum: ["dev", "prod"]
                  description: Target environment for resource provisioning
                region:
                  type: string
                  description: AWS region for deployment
                bucketName:
                  type: string
                  description: Name for the S3 assets bucket
                dbName:
                  type: string
                  description: Logical name for the PostgreSQL instance
                dbInstanceClass:
                  type: string
                  default: db.t3.micro
                  description: RDS instance class (dev: t3.micro, prod: t3.medium)
                multiAZ:
                  type: boolean
                  default: false
                  description: Enable multi-AZ deployment (prod: true)
                backupRetentionDays:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 7
                  default: 7
                  description: RDS backup retention period (>=7 required)
                iamRoleName:
                  type: string
                  description: Name for the service account IAM role
                kmsKeyArn:
                  type: string
                  description: ARN of KMS key for bucket encryption (optional, falls back to AES256)
                oidcProviderArn:
                  type: string
                  description: ARN of IAM OIDC provider for prod trust policy
```

### 2. Composition (function-patch-and-transform mode)
```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: spineinfra.aws.infra.example.com
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: infra.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: SpineInfra
  mode: Pipeline
  functions:
    - name: function-patch-and-transform
      reference:
        name: crossplane-function-patch-and-transform

  patchSets:
    - name: common-meta
      patches:
        - fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels.environment
        - fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels.region

  resources:
    # 1. S3 Bucket: Versioned, Encrypted, No Public Access
    - name: s3-bucket
      base:
        apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
        kind: Bucket
        metadata: {}
        spec:
          forProvider:
            region: ""
            versioningConfiguration:
              status: Enabled
            serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
              rules:
                - applyServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
                    sseAlgorithm: AES256
            publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
              blockPublicAcls: true
              blockPublicPolicy: true
              ignorePublicAcls: true
              restrictPublicBuckets: true
